ranks: Judgment (JUD, 2002-05-27): whole set, 102 (the rest after earlier walks took 39; the fifth middle walk, Judgment back to Odyssey)

blocked.name: Anurid Swarmsnapper
blocked.why: It can block an additional creature this turn.

blocked.name: Aven Warcraft
blocked.why: With threshold, creatures you control also gain protection from a chosen color until end of turn.

blocked.name: Balthor the Defiled
blocked.why: Its exile ability returns every black and red creature card from every graveyard to the battlefield under each owner's control; return-from-graveyard reads only the controller's graveyard and all-graveyards returns under the controller's control.

blocked.name: Barbarian Bully
blocked.why: It gets +2/+2 unless a player has it deal 4 damage to them; once one player does, no one else is asked.

blocked.name: Battlefield Scrounger
blocked.why: Its threshold ability costs putting three cards from your graveyard on the bottom of your library; no cost does that.

blocked.name: Book Burning
blocked.why: Any player may have it deal 6 damage to them; mill six only if no one does.

blocked.name: Breaking Point
blocked.why: Any player may have it deal 6 damage to them; destroy all creatures only if no one does — each-player-may has no single 'if no one did'.

blocked.name: Browbeat
blocked.why: Any player may have it deal 5 damage to them; target player draws three only if no one does.

blocked.name: Burning Wish
blocked.why: Takes a sorcery card you own from outside the game.

blocked.name: Cabal Therapy
blocked.why: Names a nonland card.

blocked.name: Cephalid Constable
blocked.why: Returns up to that many target permanents, the combat damage dealt; a target group's max can't be that amount.

blocked.name: Cunning Wish
blocked.why: Takes an instant card you own from outside the game.

blocked.name: Death Wish
blocked.why: Takes a card you own from outside the game.

blocked.name: Firecat Blitz
blocked.why: Flashback sacrifices X Mountains, and X feeds the spell; flashback's sacrifice count is fixed.

blocked.name: Flaring Pain
blocked.why: Damage can't be prevented this turn.

blocked.name: Flash of Insight
blocked.why: Flashback exiles X blue cards from your graveyard; flashback costs can't exile X cards.

blocked.name: Glory
blocked.why: From the graveyard, creatures you control gain protection from a chosen color until end of turn; no effect grants protection for a duration.

blocked.name: Golden Wish
blocked.why: Takes an artifact or enchantment card you own from outside the game.

blocked.name: Grip of Amnesia
blocked.why: Counter unless its controller exiles all cards from their graveyard (allowed with an empty graveyard).

blocked.name: Infectious Rage
blocked.why: Returns to the battlefield attached to a creature chosen at random.

blocked.name: Krosan Reclamation
blocked.why: Shuffles up to two target cards from a player's graveyard into their library; shuffle-into-library moves only permanents.

blocked.name: Lightning Surge
blocked.why: With threshold, its damage can't be prevented.

blocked.name: Living Wish
blocked.why: Takes a creature or land card you own from outside the game.

blocked.name: Lost in Thought
blocked.why: Its controller may exile three cards from their graveyard to ignore its effect until end of turn — a special action.

blocked.name: Mist of Stagnation
blocked.why: The active player untaps a permanent for each card in their graveyard, chosen by them; choose-permanents' min is fixed and its chooser is the controller.

blocked.name: Morality Shift
blocked.why: Exchanges your graveyard and library.

blocked.name: Nomad Mythmaker
blocked.why: Puts an Aura card from a graveyard onto the battlefield attached to a creature you control that it can enchant, chosen as it resolves.

blocked.name: Nullmage Advocate
blocked.why: Both target cards must come from one opponent's graveyard.

blocked.name: Phantom Centaur
blocked.why: Its ruling lets protection from black prevent damage before its own prevention, so no counter is lost; the engine always applies damage replacements before protection (rule 616.1).

blocked.name: Prismatic Strands
blocked.why: Flashback by tapping an untapped white creature, and prevents all damage from sources of a chosen color this turn.

blocked.name: Pulsemage Advocate
blocked.why: Three target cards must all come from one opponent's graveyard.

blocked.name: Quiet Speculation
blocked.why: Searches a target player's library yourself for cards with flashback; search-library's who has the target player search, and no filter reads flashback.

blocked.name: Rats' Feast
blocked.why: X target cards must all come from one graveyard.

blocked.name: Riftstone Portal
blocked.why: From the graveyard, lands you control have mana abilities; a fromGraveyard static can't grant activated abilities.

blocked.name: Scalpelexis
blocked.why: Exiles the top four cards, repeating while two of them share a name.

blocked.name: Selfless Exorcist
blocked.why: The exiled creature card deals damage equal to its power; damage from a target reads a permanent's last-known state, not a card exiled from a graveyard.

blocked.name: Serene Sunset
blocked.why: Prevents all combat damage X target creatures would deal; prevent-all-combat-damage's by is a filter, not target slots.

blocked.name: Shaman's Trance
blocked.why: Other players can't play cards from their graveyards this turn, and you may play cards from theirs as if from yours.

blocked.name: Shieldmage Advocate
blocked.why: Prevents all damage a chosen source would deal this turn; prevent-damage-from-chosen-source takes a number or next-time only.

blocked.name: Soulgorger Orgg
blocked.why: Its leaves trigger gains the life lost to its enters trigger; nothing remembers that amount.

blocked.name: Spelljack
blocked.why: You may play the exiled spell without paying its mana cost for as long as it remains exiled.

blocked.name: Spurnmage Advocate
blocked.why: Both target cards must come from one opponent's graveyard.

blocked.name: Sutured Ghoul
blocked.why: As it enters, exiles any number of creature cards from your graveyard; its P/T are their total power and toughness.

blocked.name: Web of Inertia
blocked.why: A player who doesn't exile a card from their graveyard can't attack you this turn.

blocked.name: Wormfang Behemoth
blocked.why: Exiles your whole hand until it leaves, then returns it to your hand.

blocked.name: Wormfang Crab
blocked.why: An opponent chooses the permanent of yours it exiles; choose-permanents is always chosen by the effect's controller.

blocked.name: Wormfang Manta
blocked.why: You skip your next turn when it enters.
